name: kmm-pr-review
description: PR review for Kotlin Multiplatform repos. Spawns specialist subagents per file (correctness, idiom, master-grounded) against canonical JetBrains / Android / SKIE docs — every finding cites a source or is dropped. P0–P3 prioritization with PR-induced vs pre-existing attribution so existing debt never blocks merge; iOS-readiness auto-promotes to P0 on migration PRs.
